written.headline: Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres
written.summary: Japan's largest power generator, JERA, is in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres near power plants around Tokyo. The discussions form part of JERA's broader infrastructure push, which includes a planned $15 billion hyperscale data centre in Chiba.

written.headline: Los Angeles school district blocks AI search features on student devices
written.summary: Los Angeles Unified School District has temporarily disabled AI-generated search summaries on school-issued devices amid growing friction between school districts and Google over bundled artificial intelligence tools. The half-million-student district made the change without a formal public announcement following concerns from parent and activist groups.

written.headline: Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres
written.summary: Bharti Airtel has signed an MoU with the Assam government to invest ₹1,200 crore in three data centres across Guwahati, Jorhat, and Silchar. The facilities will have a combined capacity of 40 MW and are expected to be completed by 2028.

written.headline: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman holds first Gen Z pre-budget meeting
written.summary: Indian Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman held her first dedicated pre-Budget consultation with 22 Gen Z representatives on November 26, 2026, focusing on artificial intelligence, jobs, and skill development. The meeting marked the 13th and final session in the Finance Ministry's pre-Budget consultation series for the Union Budget 2027-28.
